Literature and public sources

文献与公开来源

The catalogue contains 1,400 source records (1,399 deduplicated items across Rounds 1–8, including 1,241 research-document records, 419 verified evidence dossiers, and 22 theoretical interfaces IF-01–IF-22). This page lists 1,371 public records across 15 topical directions; the 29 internal-programme records and their private drafts are excluded.

总目录含 1,400 条来源记录（历经第 1–8 轮前沿文献与实测对齐，含 1,399 篇去重条目、1,241 条研究文献、419 篇正文证据核验档案及 22 组理论接口 IF-01–IF-22）。本页展示 15 个主题方向的 1,371 条公开记录；29 条内部纲领与草稿记录不公开。

Records retain distinct genres and versions. They are collected sources, not publications authored by Xiaoyi Li, and inclusion indicates topical relevance rather than support for the full hypothesis. Chinese titles are catalogue reading labels, not a claim of a published translation. Full-text files are not redistributed.

各记录保留体裁和版本区别，属于收集来源，不是李小毅发表的论文；收录表示主题相关，不代表支持完整假说。中文题名是目录阅读标签，不表示正式译本；不再分发文献全文。

Author fields are missing in 55 records, years in 10, and external links in 36. Missing information is left blank. Primary LaTeX sources (222 files) and real noise/simulation baselines (LIGO O3b, Holometer, Google 70Q MIPT, IceCube/KM3NeT, NAWCAD null result) are linked to the active audit dossier.

55 条记录缺作者、10 条缺年份、36 条缺外部链接；缺失处留空。核心一手 LaTeX 源码（222 份）与真实实验观测基准（LIGO O3b、Holometer、Google 70Q MIPT、IceCube/KM3NeT、海军 NAWCAD 零结果）已并入活跃验证档案。
